app.title: PalmOS Lemmings
app.author: memalign
app.description: A port of the classic Lemmings game to the PalmOS platform, providing a playable ROM and source for retro enthusiasts.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and build the ROM using the provided Makefile.
Verify the ROM runs on an emulator (e.g., Mupen64).
Check that all original game levels load correctly.
Benchmark ROM size against the original PC version.
Run a smoke test to ensure no crashes during gameplay.
